summary: Implementing rename support requires touching the GitHub client, which is outside allowed_paths.
context: Plan step s1 needs PATCH /labels/{name} with new_name. The client wrapper lives in src/lib/github.js which is covered by allowed_paths (src/**), but the call also needs a retry policy change in .github/control-plane/policies/retries.yaml, which is forbidden.
requested_decision: May the task expand scope to include policies/retries.yaml, or should rename support be split into a follow-up task?

options.description: Expand scope to include the retries policy file
options.consequences: Policy change ships with a feature change.

options.description: Ship rename without a retry policy change; open a follow-up task
options.consequences: Renames may fail transiently until follow-up lands.
